114: // integrate one course segment from state s {x,y,z,h}
115: function applySeg(s, seg) {
116:   const t = seg.turn || 0;
117:   const dz = seg.dz || 0;
118:   if (t === 0) {
119:     const rad = (s.h * Math.PI) / 180;
120:     s.x += Math.cos(rad) * seg.len;
121:     s.y += Math.sin(rad) * seg.len;
122:     s.z += dz;
123:   } else {
124:     const d = (t * Math.PI) / 180;
125:     const r = seg.r || 45;
126:     const sgn = Math.sign(t);
127:     const cx = s.x - Math.sin(s.h * Math.PI / 180) * r * sgn;
128:     const cy = s.y + Math.cos(s.h * Math.PI / 180) * r * sgn;
129:     const px = s.x - cx, py = s.y - cy;
130:     const c = Math.cos(d), sn = Math.sin(d);
131:     s.x = cx + px * c - py * sn;
132:     s.y = cy + px * sn + py * c;
133:     s.z += dz;
134:     s.h += t;
135:   }
136: }

138: // solve closing connector: arc(d1,r1) + straight(L) + arc(d2,r2) returning
139: // exactly to (0,0) with heading 0 (d1+d2 = -h by construction).
140: // Damped Gauss-Newton over (d1, r1, L, r2) with multistart + regularization.
141: function solveCloser(x, y, h) {
142:   const eod = (v) => {
143:     const s = { x, y, z: 0, h };
144:     const d2 = -h - v[0];

146:     applySeg(s, { len: Math.max(0, v[2]), turn: 0 });
147:     applySeg(s, { turn: d2, r: Math.max(8, v[3]) });
148:     return [s.x, s.y];
149:   };
150:   const costOf = (v) => {
151:     const e = eod(v);
152:     const pen = (r, lo, hi) => Math.max(0, lo - r) * 50 + Math.max(0, r - hi) * 0.5;
153:     return e[0] * e[0] + e[1] * e[1]
154:       + pen(v[1], 20, 900) + pen(v[3], 20, 900)
155:       + Math.max(0, v[2] - 900) * 400
156:       + Math.max(0, Math.abs(v[0]) - 250) * 300
157:       + Math.max(0, Math.abs(-h - v[0]) - 250) * 300
158:       + 0.02 * (v[0] * v[0] + (-h - v[0]) * (-h - v[0]));
159:   };
160:   let best = null;
161:   const rnd = (() => { let a = 12345; return () => (a = (a * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff) / 0x7fffffff; })();
162:   const seeds = [];
163:   for (const d1 of [-90, 0, 90]) for (const r of [40, 120, 400]) seeds.push([d1, r, 120, r]);
164:   for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) seeds.push([(rnd() * 2 - 1) * 200, 20 + rnd() * 500, rnd() * 600, 20 + rnd() * 500]);
165:   for (const seed of seeds) {
166:     const v = seed.slice();
167:     for (let it = 0; it < 40; it++) {
168:       const e = eod(v);
169:       if (Math.hypot(e[0], e[1]) < 0.01) break;
170:       const h1 = 1e-3;
171:       const j = [[0, 0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0]];
172:       for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
173:         const dv = v.slice();
174:         dv[k] += h1;
175:         const e2 = eod(dv);
176:         j[0][k] = (e2[0] - e[0]) / h1;
177:         j[1][k] = (e2[1] - e[1]) / h1;
178:       }
179:       // normal equations J J^T d = e  (underdetermined: min-norm step)
180:       const A = [[0, 0], [0, 0]], g = [0, 0];
181:       for (let a = 0; a < 2; a++) for (let b = 0; b < 2; b++) A[a][b] = j[a][0] * j[b][0] + j[a][1] * j[b][1] + (a === b ? 1e-4 : 0);
182:       g[0] = e[0]; g[1] = e[1];
183:       const det = A[0][0] * A[1][1] - A[0][1] * A[1][0];
184:       if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-12) break;
185:       const yv = [(A[1][1] * g[0] - A[0][1] * g[1]) / det, (-A[1][0] * g[0] + A[0][0] * g[1]) / det];
186:       const step = [
187:         j[0][0] * yv[0] + j[1][0] * yv[1],
188:         j[0][1] * yv[0] + j[1][1] * yv[1],
189:         j[0][2] * yv[0] + j[1][2] * yv[1],
190:         j[0][3] * yv[0] + j[1][3] * yv[1],
191:       ];
192:       const cur = costOf(v);
193:       let lam = 1, improved = false;
194:       for (let k = 0; k < 24; k++) {
195:         const nv = v.map((q, i2) => Math.min(3000, Math.max(-360, q - lam * step[i2])));
196:         nv[1] = Math.max(8, nv[1]); nv[3] = Math.max(8, nv[3]); nv[2] = Math.max(0, nv[2]);
197:         if (costOf(nv) < cur) { for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 4; i2++) v[i2] = nv[i2]; improved = true; break; }
198:         lam *= 0.5;
199:       }
200:       if (!improved) break;
201:     }
202:     const c = costOf(v);
203:     if (!best || c < best.cost) best = { v: v.slice(), cost: c };
204:   }
205:   const v = best.v;
206:   return { d1: v[0], r1: Math.max(8, v[1]), L: Math.max(0, v[2]), r2: Math.max(8, v[3]), d2: -h - v[0] };

209: export function compileCourse(course) {
210:   const wps = [];
211:   const meta = [];
212:   const s = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, h: 0 };
213:   let totalTurn = 0;
214:   wps.push([s.x, s.y, s.z]);
215:   const emit = (seg) => {
216:     if (seg.name || seg.bank || seg.concrete) meta.push({ wp: wps.length - 1, name: seg.name || null, bank: seg.bank || 0, concrete: !!seg.concrete });
217:     const before = [s.x, s.y, s.z, s.h];
218:     applySeg(s, seg);
219:     if ((seg.turn || 0) !== 0) {
220:       const midS = { x: before[0], y: before[1], z: before[2], h: before[3] };
221:       applySeg(midS, { turn: seg.turn / 2, r: seg.r || 45, dz: (seg.dz || 0) / 2 });
222:       wps.push([midS.x, midS.y, midS.z]);
223:     }
224:     wps.push([s.x, s.y, s.z]);
225:     totalTurn += seg.turn || 0;
226:   };
227:   for (const seg of course) emit(seg);
228:   const namedTurn = totalTurn;
229:   const zEnd = s.z;
230:   const closer = solveCloser(s.x, s.y, s.h);
231:   const l1 = closer.r1 * Math.abs(closer.d1 * Math.PI / 180);
232:   const l2 = closer.L;
233:   const l3 = closer.r2 * Math.abs(closer.d2 * Math.PI / 180);
234:   const lt = l1 + l2 + l3 || 1;
235:   const dzk = -zEnd;
236:   emit({ turn: closer.d1, r: closer.r1, dz: dzk * l1 / lt, name: null });
237:   emit({ len: closer.L, turn: 0, dz: dzk * l2 / lt, name: null });
238:   emit({ turn: closer.d2, r: closer.r2, dz: dzk * l3 / lt, name: null });
239:   return { wps, meta, totalTurn: namedTurn, closer, endHeading: s.h, gap: Math.hypot(s.x, s.y), endX: s.x, endY: s.y };
240: }

242: const EPS = 1e-6;
243: 
244: function catmull(p0, p1, p2, p3, t, alpha) {
245:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], (b[2] || 0) - (a[2] || 0));
246:   const t0 = 0;
247:   const t1 = t0 + Math.pow(dist(p0, p1), alpha);
248:   const t2 = t1 + Math.pow(dist(p1, p2), alpha);
249:   const t3 = t2 + Math.pow(dist(p2, p3), alpha);
250:   const tt = t1 + t * (t2 - t1);
251:   const A1 = lerpP(p0, p1, (tt - t0) / (t1 - t0 + EPS));
252:   const A2 = lerpP(p1, p2, (tt - t1) / (t2 - t1 + EPS));
253:   const A3 = lerpP(p2, p3, (tt - t2) / (t3 - t2 + EPS));
254:   const B1 = lerpP(A1, A2, (tt - t0) / (t2 - t0 + EPS));
255:   const B2 = lerpP(A2, A3, (tt - t1) / (t3 - t1 + EPS));
256:   return lerpP(B1, B2, (tt - t1) / (t2 - t1 + EPS));
257: }
258: function lerpP(a, b, u) {
259:   return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * u, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u, (a[2] || 0) + ((b[2] || 0) - (a[2] || 0)) * u];
260: }

262: export function buildTrack(def) {

264:   const wps = cc.wps;
265:   const n = wps.length;
266:   const dense = [];

270:     for (let k = 0; k < SUB; k++) dense.push(catmull(p0, p1, p2, p3, k / SUB, 0.5));
271:   }
272:   const step = 1.0;

308:       tx: dx / hl, ty: dy / hl,
309:       yaw: Math.atan2(dy, dx),
310:       pitch: Math.atan2(dz, hl),

317:     const a2 = Math.atan2(c.y - b.y, c.x - b.x);
318:     let d = a2 - a1;
319:     while (d > Math.PI) d -= 2 * Math.PI;

324:   // name spans: map meta wp positions onto spline arc length

Actually let me verify the gradient: is 42.8% real or an artifact of pitch calculation? pitch = atan2(dz, hl), where dz is per 1m… dz = (z[i+1]-z[i-1])/2, hl = chord between i±1 ≈ 2m… hl is the xy chord and dz is per 2 samples → gradient = dz/hl. Fine.

**Bug 5: Tsukuba "S-Hairpin"**: 55m arc at 188° → arc length = 24*188*π/180 = 78.7m ≠ 55m! Bug in the course authoring convention: in applySeg, `len` is the arc length traveled but… let me re-check applySeg: for a turn segment, it rotates by `d = t` radians around a center at radius r — the arc length traversed = r * |d| radians, which is not seg.len! So the `len` field on turn segments is completely ignored! For t≠0: s.x = rotation of point around center by angle d. Arc length = r*|t_rad|. E.g. Tsukuba Turn 1: len 80, turn 38, r 70 → actual arc = 70*0.663 = 46.4m, not 80. And the S-Hairpin: len 55 but 188° at r24 = 78.7m. Suzuka's 130R: len 300, turn 165 at r120 → actual arc 120*2.88 = 345m. So `len` on turn segments is a red herring — it's not used. This is a bona fide bug in the track system: either applySeg should travel an arc of length `len` and compute the heading change as len/r, or the authoring side expects len to control length. The author clearly intended `len` to be the segment length (they write name comments and plausible lengths). This mismatch means the actual lengths of all turn segments are r*|turn| instead of len — causing total length mismatches (Tsukuba's authored sum: 430+80+60+90+150+250+110+180+60+55+55+240+90+100+240+130+120 = 2340 but real Tsukuba is 2045, and turn arcs become shorter/longer).

This is the big authoring bug: `len` is ignored for curved segments. Two consistent fixes: (a) treat turn as the heading change and length as derived (= r*t) — document it; (b) honor len: actual turn angle = len/r. The HUD/name mapping uses heading consistency… solveCloser relies on heading: applySeg rotates heading by t. If we change applySeg to use len, the heading change per segment changes = len/r radians → totalTurn changes. The closing solver adjusts. But authoring intent: they chose `turn` (degrees) and `r` and `len` semi-independently — often inconsistent (Tsukuba Turn 1: len80, turn38, r70 → r*|t|=46 ≠ 80; len/r=1.14 rad = 65° ≠ 38°). So the course data itself is internally contradictory — needs a rule. The most defensible: heading change = turn (that's the corner shape), length = r*|turn| (arc), and `len` is decorative/ignored — but then Tsukuba's S-Hairpin "55" is decorative too. Or use len as authoritative for straights, and turn & r for corners.

        nv[1] = Math.max(8, nv[1]); nv[3] = Math.max(8, nv[3]); nv[2] = Math.max(0, nv[2]);
        if (costOf(nv) < cur) { for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 4; i2++) v[i2] = nv[i2]; improved = true; break; }
        lam *= 0.5;
      }
      if (!improved) break;

    const c = costOf(v);
    if (!best || c < best.cost) best = { v: v.slice(), cost: c };

export function compileCourse(course, wind = 0) {
  const wps = [];
  const meta = [];
  const s = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, h: 0 };
  let totalTurn = 0;
  wps.push([s.x, s.y, s.z]);
  const emit = (seg) => {
    if (seg.name || seg.bank || seg.concrete) meta.push({ wp: wps.length - 1, name: seg.name || null, bank: seg.bank || 0, concrete: !!seg.concrete });
    // sample arcs densely enough that the smoothing spline follows the true
    // arc; one midpoint for a 188 deg hairpin or a 244 deg closer arc cuts
    // corners badly and kinks the start/finish seam
    const t = seg.turn || 0;
    const n = t ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(t) / 20)) : 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      applySeg(s, { len: (seg.len || 0) / n, turn: t / n, r: seg.r || 45, dz: (seg.dz || 0) / n });
      wps.push([s.x, s.y, s.z]);
    }
    totalTurn += t;
  };
  for (const seg of course) emit(seg);
  const namedTurn = totalTurn;
  const zEnd = s.z;
  const preEnd = { x: s.x, y: s.y, z: s.z, h: s.h };
  const closer = solveCloser(s.x, s.y, s.h, wind);
  const l1 = closer.r1 * Math.abs(closer.d1 * Math.PI / 180);
  const l2 = closer.L;
  const l3 = closer.r2 * Math.abs(closer.d2 * Math.PI / 180);
  const lt = l1 + l2 + l3 || 1;
  const dzk = -zEnd;
  emit({ turn: closer.d1, r: closer.r1, dz: dzk * l1 / lt, name: null });
  emit({ len: closer.L, turn: 0, dz: dzk * l2 / lt, name: null });
  emit({ turn: closer.d2, r: closer.r2, dz: dzk * l3 / lt, name: null });
  return { wps, meta, totalTurn: namedTurn, closer, endHeading: s.h, gap: Math.hypot(s.x, s.y), endX: s.x, endY: s.y, preEnd };
}

```json
{
  "content": "// Tuner: integrate a course array (same math as compileCourse) and report\n// turn sum, arc/straight lengths, and the preEnd approach state vs origin.\n// Usage: node tools/coursetune.mjs [trackId]\nimport { TRACKS } from \"../src/tracks.js\";\n\nconst D = Math.PI / 180;\nfunction integrate(course, h0 = 0) {\n  let x = 0, y = 0, h = h0, z = 0, arc = 0, str = 0, turn = 0;\n  for (const c of course) {\n    const t = c.t ?? c.turn ?? 0;\n    const len = c.s ?? c.len ?? 0;\n    const r = Math.abs(c.r ?? 45);\n    z += c.dz ?? 0;\n    turn += t;\n    if (!t) { str += len; x += Math.cos(h * D) * len; y += Math.sin(h * D) * len; continue; }\n    arc += r * Math.abs(t) * D;\n    const sign = t > 0 ? 1 : -1;\n    const a0 = (h - 90) * D, a1 = a0 + t * D;\n    const cx = x + r * Math.cos(a0 + sign * Math.PI / 2);\n    const cy = y + r * Math.sin(a0 + sign * Math.PI / 2);\n    x = cx + r * Math.cos(a1); y = cy + r * Math.sin(a1);\n    h += t;\n  }\n  return { x, y, h, z, arc, str, turn };\n}\nconst id = process.argv[2] || \"nordschleife\";\nconst def = TRACKS.find((t) => t.id === id);\nconst s = integrate(def.course);\nconst dist = Math.hypot(s.x, s.y);\nconst home = Math.atan2(-s.y, -s.x) / D;\nconst headErr = ((s.h - home + 540) % 360) - 180;\nconst needCloser = (def.wind || 0) * 360 - s.turn;\nconsole.log(`${def.name}  wind=${def.wind}`);\nconsole.log(`turn sum=${s.turn.toFixed(1)}  arc=${s.arc.toFixed(0)}m straight=${s.str.toFixed(0)}m total=${(s.arc + s.str).toFixed(0)}m  zEnd=${s.z}`);\nconsole.log(`closer must turn: ${needCloser.toFixed(1)} deg`);\nconsole.log(`preEnd: pos=(${s.x.toFixed(0)},${s.y.toFixed(0)}) dist=${dist.toFixed(0)}m h=${s.h.toFixed(0)} headErrToHome=${headErr.toFixed(0)} zEnd=${s.z}`);\nconst want = (def.wind || 0) * 360;\nconsole.log(`advisory: for wind ${def.wind}, turn sum should be near ${want} ± 400; headErr ideally within +/-40 of 0, dist 300..1500`);\n",
  "path": "/home/dave/voxel/gt-opencode-qwen/tools/coursetune.mjs"
}
```

```
function refine(f, v0) {
  let v = v0.slice(), stepv=[80,300,400,300], best=f(v);
  for (let round=0; round<80; round++) {
    let improved=false;
    for (let i=0;i<4;i++){
      for (const sgn of [1,-1]) {
        const w=v.slice(); w[i]+=sgn*stepv[i]; clip(w);
        const c=f(w); if(c<best){v=w;best=c;improved=true;}
      }
    }
    if(!improved){ stepv=stepv.map(x=>x*0.6); if (stepv[0]<0.5) break; }
  }
  return {v,best};
}
```

function applySeg(s, seg) {
  const t = seg.turn;
  s.z += seg.dz || 0;
  if (!t) {
    s.x += Math.cos(s.h * Math.PI / 180) * seg.len;
    s.y += Math.sin(s.h * Math.PI / 180) * seg.len;
    return;
  }
  const r = Math.abs(seg.r);
  // true circular arc: chord = 2r sin(|t|/2) in the direction of the mid
  // heading (h + t/2). The center-offset form is only correct if the center
  // is placed at h + sign(t)*90; getting that wrong kinks every chunked arc.
  const chord = 2 * r * Math.sin(Math.abs(t) * Math.PI / 360);
  const mid = (s.h + t / 2) * Math.PI / 180;

    applySeg(s, { len: L, turn: 0 });
    applySeg(s, { len: 0, turn: tgt - d1, r: r2, dz: 0 });
    // heading closure is exact by construction (d1 + d2 = tgt = windK*360 - h),
    // so only the position gap is a free residual
    return { dx: s.x - x, dy: s.y - y };
  };

// Real-world track definitions for GranVoxel.
// Courses are described as real-world centerline arcs (measured in meters).
// Each segment: straight = { s, dz, bank }, arc = { r, t, dz, bank } where
// t is the heading change in degrees (positive = right turn). The drawn arc
// length is r*|t| (radians); any `s`/`len` on a turning segment is ignored.
// dz = elevation change across the segment (m).
// `wind` is the topological turning number of the completed lap:
// -1 = one net clockwise revolution (Tsukuba, Nordschleife),
//  0 = figure-eight with odd number of crossings (Suzuka).
// The closer arcs are solved so the spline closes smoothly (matching heading)
// AND the lap realizes that winding number; courses must therefore have turn
// sums close to wind*360 deg.
// World-space z is base + dz (base differs per track); dz values in courses
// are relative heights that the closer brings back to the start elevation.

" DECLARED" : ""}`).join("\n"));
  const feas = cands.filter((c) => c.posGap < 2.5);
  const declaredFeas = feas.filter((c) => c.declared);
  const pool = declaredFeas.length ? declaredFeas : feas.length ? feas : cands;
  pool.sort((a, b) => a.len - b.len || a.posGap - b.posGap);
  const best = pool[0];
  const [d1, r1, L, r2] = best.v;
  return { d1, r1, L, r2, d2: best.tgt - d1 };

const EPS = 1e-6;

function catmull(p0, p1, p2, p3, t, alpha) {
  const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], (b[2] || 0) - (a[2] || 0));
  const t0 = 0;
  const t1 = t0 + Math.pow(dist(p0, p1), alpha);
  const t2 = t1 + Math.pow(dist(p1, p2), alpha);
  const t3 = t2 + Math.pow(dist(p2, p3), alpha);
  const tt = t1 + t * (t2 - t1);
  const A1 = lerpP(p0, p1, (tt - t0) / (t1 - t0 + EPS));
  const A2 = lerpP(p1, p2, (tt - t1) / (t2 - t1 + EPS));
  const A3 = lerpP(p2, p3, (tt - t2) / (t3 - t2 + EPS));
  const B1 = lerpP(A1, A2, (tt - t0) / (t2 - t0 + EPS));
  const B2 = lerpP(A2, A3, (tt - t1) / (t3 - t1 + EPS));
  return lerpP(B1, B2, (tt - t1) / (t2 - t1 + EPS));
}
function lerpP(a, b, u) {
  return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * u, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u, (a[2] || 0) + ((b[2] || 0) - (a[2] || 0)) * u];

const EPS = 1e-6;

function catmull(p0, p1, p2, p3, t, alpha) {
  const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], (b[2] || 0) - (a[2] || 0));
  const t0 = 0;
  const t1 = t0 + Math.pow(dist(p0, p1), alpha);
  const t2 = t1 + Math.pow(dist(p1, p2), alpha);
  const t3 = t2 + Math.pow(dist(p2, p3), alpha);
  const tt = t1 + t * (t2 - t1);
  const A1 = lerpP(p0, p1, (tt - t0) / (t1 - t0 + EPS));
  const A2 = lerpP(p1, p2, (tt - t1) / (t2 - t1 + EPS));
  const A3 = lerpP(p2, p3, (tt - t2) / (t3 - t2 + EPS));
  const B1 = lerpP(A1, A2, (tt - t0) / (t2 - t0 + EPS));
  const B2 = lerpP(A2, A3, (tt - t1) / (t3 - t1 + EPS));
  return lerpP(B1, B2, (tt - t1) / (t2 - t1 + EPS));
}
